create_ShardSpec: create a ShardSpec dataclass with a sharded dimension and optional region boundary flag
build_LinearSharder: build a LinearSharder to shard Linear modules into ColumnShardedLinear or RowShardedLinear variants
build_EmbeddingSharder: build an EmbeddingSharder to shard StandardEmbedding modules into VocabShardedEmbedding or ShardedEmbedding variants
create_ModelSharder: create a ModelSharder subclass to define custom model sharding logic for tensor parallelism
run_StandardModelSharder: run StandardModelSharder to recursively shard model modules matching regex patterns against provided ShardSpec mappings
